patterns.description:
Ok so I have n8n query presenting in the last 3 hours all publishers, their impressions and revenue every 15 min. Can we build some n8n running every 20 min. And checking per each publisher if there was a decrease in revenue that is more than X% lower suddenly? 

Here's example (attached) where yahoo suddenly dropped in revenue and I would like the n8n to detect such cases and alert me in any way. I have this query in BigQuery : WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(timestamp), 900) * 900) AS ts_15m,
    supply_partner,
    SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
    SUM(revenue) AS revenue
  FROM `streamrail.bi_production.seller_live_data_spark`
  WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT
    supply_partner,
    ts_15m,
    revenue,
    impressions,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY supply_partner ORDER BY ts_15m) AS rev_prev,
    LAG(impressions) OVER (PARTITION BY supply_partner ORDER BY ts_15m) AS imp_prev
  FROM buckets
),
drops AS (
  SELECT
    supply_partner,
    rev_prev,
    revenue AS rev_now,
    (rev_prev - revenue) AS loss_abs,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue - rev_prev, rev_prev) AS change_pct
  FROM pairs
  WHERE rev_prev IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
REGEXP_EXTRACT(supply_partner, r'^([^_]+)') AS supply_org,
REGEXP_REPLACE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(supply_partner, r'^[^_]+_(.*)$'), r'-$', '') AS name,
  rev_prev,
  rev_now,
  loss_abs,
  change_pct
FROM drops
WHERE
  rev_prev >= 100
  AND loss_abs >= 100
  AND change_pct <= -0.70
ORDER BY loss_abs DESC;

patterns.issuePattern: The workflow uses Gmail as the data source instead of Slack channels as requested.

patterns.issuePattern: The 'Get Slack History' node fetches the last 50 messages regardless of when they were sent, which means it will summarize the same old messages every 30 minutes rather than just the new ones.
patterns.fixApplied: Added 'Oldest' filter to Slack node using $now.minus({ minutes: 30 }) to fetch only recent messages.
patterns.description: I would like to have a flow running every 30 min. taking info from few slack channels, detecting critical things / subject / issues - summarizing it and sending me back to slack and email.

patterns.fixApplied: Introduced a 'Define Channels' Set node to allow monitoring multiple Slack channels dynamically.

patterns.issuePattern: The 'Basic LLM Chain' uses '{{ $json.text }}' after an Aggregate node; in n8n, this will typically only pass the first message of the aggregated array to the AI, rather than the full combined text of all messages.
patterns.fixApplied: Configured the Slack History node to use expressions for the channel ID, enabling looping over multiple channels.
patterns.description: I would like to have a flow running every 30 min. taking info from few slack channels, detecting critical things / subject / issues - summarizing it and sending me back to slack and email.

patterns.issuePattern: In the Slack node, set the 'Oldest' filter to '{{ $now.minus({ minutes: 30 }).toSeconds() }}' to ensure only messages from the last 30 minutes are processed.
patterns.fixApplied: Updated Aggregate node to join all message 'text' fields into a single 'combinedText' string with delimiters.
